# OzoBath

> OzoBath manufactures and retails premium shower enclosures, glass partitions,
> shower panels and designer bathroom fittings across India. Products use
> toughened safety glass and corrosion-resistant hardware, with nationwide
> delivery and professional installation.

OzoBath is an Indian direct-to-consumer bathroomware brand. The catalogue covers
shower enclosures (sliding, hinged, corner and custom), glass partitions, shower
panels, basin mixers, faucets and bathroom accessories. Shower enclosures are
made to measure, so those products are sold through a site-visit and quotation
flow rather than direct checkout; accessories and fittings are bought online.

## Products

- [Shop all products](https://ozobath.in/shop): Full catalogue with category, price and finish filters.
- [Shower enclosures](https://ozobath.in/shop?category=shower-enclosures): Made-to-measure toughened glass enclosures.
- [Bathroom fittings](https://ozobath.in/shop?category=fittings): Mixers, faucets, showers and accessories.
- [Shop Live](https://ozobath.in/shop-live): Guided video shopping with a product consultant.

## Services

- [Book a site visit](https://ozobath.in/book-site-visit): On-site measurement and quotation for enclosures.
- [Experience Centre](https://ozobath.in/experience-centre): Visit a showroom to see products in person.
- [B2B enquiry](https://ozobath.in/b2b-enquiry): Bulk and project pricing for builders, architects and hotels.
- [Service request](https://ozobath.in/service-request): Installation support and after-sales service.
- [Track an order](https://ozobath.in/track-order): Order and delivery status lookup.
